mapper.sql: l.id, l.student_id, l.leave_type, l.start_date, l.end_date, l.days, l.reason, l.status, l.approver_id, l.approver_name, l.approve_time, l.approve_remark, l.create_time, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS studentName, s.class_id AS classId, c.class_name AS className, CASE l.status WHEN 0 THEN '待审批' WHEN 1 THEN '已通过' WHEN 2 THEN '已驳回' WHEN 3 THEN '已撤销' ELSE '未知' END AS statusText
FROM att_leave l INNER JOIN stu_student s ON s.id = l.student_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_class c ON c.id = s.class_id AND c.deleted = 0
